author: Elastic
description: 检测Windows执行持久化可疑程序。对应需求：持久化。官方：Execution of Persistent Suspicious Program。
name: 【默认】Windows执行持久化可疑程序
note:
## 调查指引

### 规则说明
Windows执行持久化可疑程序

### 为何重要
在重启或登录后保持立足点

### 调查步骤
1. 核对告警实体、进程/网络字段与时间窗。
2. 核对是否符合变更窗口与已知业务工具。
3. 关联同主机或同账号前后同类告警。

### 常见误报
- 合法变更窗口内的运维、发布或安全扫描

### 响应建议
1. 确认是否授权与变更窗口。
2. 无授权则隔离相关主机或账号并排查落地与外连。
3. 按主机与用户关联前后同类告警。
query:
/* userinit followed by explorer followed by early child process of explorer (unlikely to be launched interactively) within 1m */
sequence by host.id, user.name with maxspan=1m
  [process where host.os.type == "windows" and event.type == "start" and process.name : "userinit.exe" and process.parent.name : "winlogon.exe"]
  [process where host.os.type == "windows" and event.type == "start" and process.name : "explorer.exe"]
  [process where host.os.type == "windows" and event.type == "start" and process.parent.name : "explorer.exe" and
   /* add suspicious programs here */
   process.pe.original_file_name in ("cscript.exe",
                                     "wscript.exe",
                                     "PowerShell.EXE",
                                     "MSHTA.EXE",
                                     "RUNDLL32.EXE",
                                     "REGSVR32.EXE",
                                     "RegAsm.exe",
                                     "MSBuild.exe",
                                     "InstallUtil.exe") and
    /* add potential suspicious paths here */
    process.args : ("C:\\Users\\*", "C:\\ProgramData\\*", "C:\\Windows\\Temp\\*", "C:\\Windows\\Tasks\\*", "C:\\PerfLogs\\*", "C:\\Intel\\*")
   ]
setup:
## 设置说明

1. 目标 Windows 主机安装 Elastic Agent，启用 **Elastic Defend**（按规则需要进程/网络/文件/注册表或安全日志）。
2. 确认相关数据流有数据后再评估告警。
false_positives: 合法变更窗口内的运维、发布或安全扫描
